newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian traders mixed over bourse's trend.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian traders mixed over bourse's trend.

text.p: Hungarian traders were divided over the direction of price movements on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
One trader said he expected prices to consolidate after recent gains, while another said he was convinced that the rising trend would continue.
"I expect the market to consolidate today," said Geza Raner of Bank Austria-GiroCredit Befektetesi Rt.
"In the near future third-quarter corporate results will influence prices," he said.
But Attila Hunyadi of Buda-Cash Brokerhaz said he expected the bullish trend to prevail, led by the bourse's two chemicals companies, Borsodchem and TVK.
"Borsodchem's assessment is very positive and this might draw the attention to TVK," Hunyadi said. "I expect the market to extend its recent gains."
Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt completed the private placement of 1.2 million Borsodchem shares earlier this week.
On Tuesday the BUX index hit its third successive high and ended at 3,692.06 points, up 9.88.
